sources.title: Dogacel/Qwen3-8B-DSpark · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A DSpark speculative-decoding draft model for Qwen/Qwen3-8B, trained with TorchSpec. DSpark combines a DFlash block-diffusion drafter with EAGLE-style Markov and confidence heads. This repository contains only the draft model. It is used together with the unmodified Qwen/Qwen3-8B target model at ...

sources.title: yushengsu/dense-1-8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Per-epoch checkpoints of one SpecForge run: the Qwen3-8B dense DSpark drafter (causal draft block, block 16, no confidence head) shrunk in structure only: 2 layers instead of 5, attention GQA 8/2 heads x 128 (1/4 of the dense arm's width), MLP intermediate_size 1536 (1/8 of 12288); residual hidden stays 4096. About 0.22B parameters.
